from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window


target_table = "odw_harmonised_db.sap_hr_inspector_specialisms"
staging_table = "odw_harmonised_db.sap_hr_inspector_specialisms_cleanup"


# Read existing harmonised table
df = spark.table(target_table)

original_count = df.count()

print("Original row count:", original_count)


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Remove exact duplicate versions
# Keep the latest ingestion record
# ---------------------------------------------------------

dedup_window = Window.partitionBy(
    "RowID",
    "ValidFrom",
    "ValidTo",
    "IsActive"
).orderBy(
    F.col("IngestionDate").desc()
)

df_clean = (
    df
    .withColumn(
        "rn",
        F.row_number().over(dedup_window)
    )
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .drop("rn")
)

dedup_count = df_clean.count()

print("Rows after deduplication:", dedup_count)
print(
    "Duplicate rows removed:",
    original_count - dedup_count
)


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Remove invalid StaffNumbers such as 0000NULL
# ---------------------------------------------------------

df_clean = (
    df_clean
    .filter(
        F.col("StaffNumber").isNotNull()
        & F.trim(
            F.col("StaffNumber")
        ).cast("long").isNotNull()
    )
)

valid_staff_count = df_clean.count()

print(
    "Rows after removing invalid StaffNumbers:",
    valid_staff_count
)


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Correct Current / IsActive
# Keep one active record for each
# StaffNumber + QualificationName + Proficien
# ---------------------------------------------------------

active_window = Window.partitionBy(
    "StaffNumber",
    "QualificationName",
    "Proficien"
).orderBy(
    F.col("Current").desc(),
    F.col("ValidFrom").desc_nulls_last(),
    F.col("IngestionDate").desc_nulls_last(),
    F.col("LastUpdated").desc_nulls_last()
)

df_final = (
    df_clean
    .withColumn(
        "active_rank",
        F.row_number().over(active_window)
    )
    .withColumn(
        "IsActive",
        F.when(
            F.col("active_rank") == 1,
            F.lit("Y")
        ).otherwise(
            F.lit("N")
        )
    )
    .withColumn(
        "Current",
        F.when(
            F.col("active_rank") == 1,
            F.lit(1)
        ).otherwise(
            F.lit(0)
        )
    )
    .drop("active_rank")
)

final_count = df_final.count()

print("Final cleaned row count:", final_count)


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Validate BEFORE writing
# ---------------------------------------------------------

duplicate_active_keys = (
    df_final
    .filter(
        F.col("IsActive") == "Y"
    )
    .groupBy(
        "StaffNumber",
        "QualificationName",
        "Proficien"
    )
    .count()
    .filter(
        F.col("count") > 1
    )
    .count()
)

invalid_staffnumbers = (
    df_final
    .filter(
        F.col("StaffNumber").isNull()
        | F.trim(
            F.col("StaffNumber")
        ).cast("long").isNull()
    )
    .count()
)

print(
    "Duplicate active keys:",
    duplicate_active_keys
)

print(
    "Invalid StaffNumbers:",
    invalid_staffnumbers
)


if duplicate_active_keys > 0:
    raise Exception(
        "Validation failed. "
        f"{duplicate_active_keys} "
        "duplicate active keys remain."
    )


if invalid_staffnumbers > 0:
    raise Exception(
        "Validation failed. "
        f"{invalid_staffnumbers} "
        "invalid StaffNumbers remain."
    )


print("Pre-write validation passed")

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Write cleaned data to staging
# ---------------------------------------------------------

(
    df_final.write
    .format("delta")
    .mode("overwrite")
    .option("overwriteSchema", "true")
    .saveAsTable(staging_table)
)

staging_df = spark.table(staging_table)

staging_count = staging_df.count()

print("Staging row count:", staging_count)


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Validate staging
# ---------------------------------------------------------

staging_duplicate_keys = (
    staging_df
    .filter(
        F.col("IsActive") == "Y"
    )
    .groupBy(
        "StaffNumber",
        "QualificationName",
        "Proficien"
    )
    .count()
    .filter(
        F.col("count") > 1
    )
    .count()
)

staging_invalid_staffnumbers = (
    staging_df
    .filter(
        F.col("StaffNumber").isNull()
        | F.trim(
            F.col("StaffNumber")
        ).cast("long").isNull()
    )
    .count()
)


if staging_count != final_count:
    raise Exception(
        "Staging row-count validation failed. "
        f"Expected {final_count}, "
        f"found {staging_count}."
    )


if staging_duplicate_keys > 0:
    raise Exception(
        "Staging validation failed. "
        f"{staging_duplicate_keys} "
        "duplicate active keys remain."
    )


if staging_invalid_staffnumbers > 0:
    raise Exception(
        "Staging validation failed. "
        f"{staging_invalid_staffnumbers} "
        "invalid StaffNumbers remain."
    )


print("Staging validation passed")


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 7. Overwrite original harmonised table
# ---------------------------------------------------------

(
    staging_df.write
    .format("delta")
    .mode("overwrite")
    .option("overwriteSchema", "true")
    .saveAsTable(target_table)
)

target_df = spark.table(target_table)

target_count = target_df.count()

print(
    "Target row count after cleanup:",
    target_count
)


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 8. Final validation on actual target
# ---------------------------------------------------------

target_duplicate_keys = (
    target_df
    .filter(
        F.col("IsActive") == "Y"
    )
    .groupBy(
        "StaffNumber",
        "QualificationName",
        "Proficien"
    )
    .count()
    .filter(
        F.col("count") > 1
    )
    .count()
)

target_invalid_staffnumbers = (
    target_df
    .filter(
        F.col("StaffNumber").isNull()
        | F.trim(
            F.col("StaffNumber")
        ).cast("long").isNull()
    )
    .count()
)


if target_count != staging_count:
    raise Exception(
        "Target row-count validation failed. "
        f"Staging has {staging_count}, "
        f"target has {target_count}."
    )


if target_duplicate_keys > 0:
    raise Exception(
        "Final validation failed. "
        f"{target_duplicate_keys} "
        "duplicate active keys remain."
    )


if target_invalid_staffnumbers > 0:
    raise Exception(
        "Final validation failed. "
        f"{target_invalid_staffnumbers} "
        "invalid StaffNumbers remain."
    )


print("Final target validation passed")
print("Final target row count:", target_count)


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 9. Remove temporary staging table
# ---------------------------------------------------------

spark.sql(
    f"DROP TABLE IF EXISTS {staging_table}"
)
